def ssh_connect() → paramiko.SSHClient

def remote_mtime(client: paramiko.SSHClient, path: str) → int|None
def check_clean(spec: RepoSpec) → bool
def check_branch(spec: RepoSpec) → bool  # 返回 (behind, ahead)。
def check_ahead(spec: RepoSpec) → tuple[int, int]  # 返回 (behind, ahead)。
def push_branch(spec: RepoSpec, dry_run: bool) → bool
def wait_artifact_updated(client: paramiko.SSHClient, spec: RepoSpec, initial_mtimes: dict[str, int?], timeout: int, poll_interval: int) → dict[str, bool]  # 轮询远端产物 mtime，直到都更新或超时。
def health_check(client: paramiko.SSHClient, spec: RepoSpec) → bool  # Backend 健康检查走远端 curl 调 sync(query)；前端健康走 HEAD 200。
def deploy(spec: RepoSpec, args) → dict
def main() → int

```
@dataclass RepoSpec(name, local_path, expected_branch)
def log(level: str, msg: str) → None
def run_local(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path, capture: bool, check: bool) → subprocess.CompletedProcess
def gh_available() → bool  # 通过 gh workflow run 触发 workflow_dispatch。
def gh_authenticated() → bool  # 通过 gh workflow run 触发 workflow_dispatch。
def gh_workflow_run(spec: RepoSpec, git_ref: str, extra_inputs: Optional[dict[str, str]]) → bool  # 通过 gh workflow run 触发 workflow_dispatch。
def gh_latest_run_id(spec: RepoSpec, git_ref: str, max_age_seconds: int) → str|None  # 拿到刚触发的最新 run id（按 createdAt 倒序，且分支匹配）。
def gh_watch_run(spec: RepoSpec, run_id: str, timeout: int) → str|None  # gh run watch 阻塞到 run 完成；返回 conclusion (success/failure/cance
def ssh_connect() → paramiko.SSHClient
def ssh_run(client: paramiko.SSHClient, cmd: str, timeout: int) → tuple[str, str, int]
def remote_mtime(client: paramiko.SSHClient, path: str) → int|None
def check_clean(spec: RepoSpec) → bool
def get_current_branch(spec: RepoSpec) → str|None
def check_branch(spec: RepoSpec, strict: bool) → tuple[bool, str|None]
def check_ahead(spec: RepoSpec) → tuple[int, int]  # 返回 (behind, ahead)。
def push_branch(spec: RepoSpec, branch: str, dry_run: bool) → bool
def wait_artifact_updated(client: paramiko.SSHClient, spec: RepoSpec, initial_mtimes: dict[str, int?], timeout: int, poll_interval: int) → dict[str, bool]  # 轮询远端产物 mtime，直到都更新或超时。
def health_check(client: paramiko.SSHClient, spec: RepoSpec) → bool  # Backend 健康检查走远端 curl 调 sync(query)；前端健康走 HEAD 200。
def deploy(spec: RepoSpec, args) → dict
def main() → int
```
